source.license: ODC-BY; attribution and source terms are in the pinned upstream README
source.immutability: The pinned source remains untouched; each freeze is a new immutable local descendant.

selection.selection_key: seeded hash of prompt_id, prompt hash, and sorted response hashes; never chosen/rejected order, score, or model output
selection.partition_key: seeded category hash only; whole categories remain together and no label, score, or model output participates

execution.task: endpoint-neutral pairwise A/B/TIE judgment with response side assigned by exact response SHA-256
execution.grok_sol_task_bytes: must be identical for each frozen cell
execution.default_schedule: TRAIN and DEV only; confirmation is absent
execution.confirmation: selected and locally committed, but not executable here; a future real pairwise analyzer/profile-decision package must define and bind any opening contract
execution.local_targets: separate from execution inputs and never disclosed to providers

analysis.score_scale: Do not compute MAE across the 0-3 source scores.
analysis.family_weights: TRAIN fit only; DEV selects a frozen candidate; this source-freeze package cannot open confirmation

authority.selection: development-only; no confirmation-opening surface exists in this package
